gen-gf-flamenco-fs-rowan: Flamenco draws tube-like letters of constant width, with bowls as heavy as the stems. Rowan sits beside it with generous curves and a faint thinning at the turns, friendly and bookish, though not built for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-fondamento-fs-amulya: Graceful and relaxed, Fondamento writes like a casual hand, its c tips never creeping toward touching. And Amulya follows with modern, generously open curves, so a larger heading over modestly sized text feels natural.
gen-gf-fondamento-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its thin lines sturdy and its thick ones only slightly heavier. But Fondamento's casual, pen-drawn heading would feel lost if made too small, and the body would feel stiff if enlarged.
gen-gf-fondamento-fs-recia: Fondamento's casual, pen-and-paper letters keep their c tips well apart, giving it a graceful, relaxed handwriting feel. Recia adds sharper, authoritative text, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-fondamento-outfit: Fondamento brings graceful, relaxed letters that look written by hand, with c tips that never creep toward touching. But Outfit answers in cable-like lines with no swelling or thinning, clean and approachable for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-bhutuka-expande: Spaghetti-like strokes, all one width, give Funnel Display a loud, commanding look. And BhuTuka Expanded One slows the eye to a leisurely walk, its curvy, literary letters and thin joins as sturdy as the stems.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-familjen-grotesk: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles draws rounded, bent-tubing letters. Familjen Grotesk is lively and sans-serif, with bowls left unfinished on one side, and its size can stay modest beside that heading.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-technor: Fuzzy Bubbles writes with rounded, inviting letters and the steady line of a drafting pen. Technor sits opposite it, cool and geometric like neon tube, which gives this pair its sharpest quality: warm hand against glowing line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, its middle band generous and its ascenders and descenders shallow, with a wide entry into the e. Gabarito's heading can go larger above it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-hanuman: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut open. Hanuman settles beneath it in a traditional, refined voice, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals making a long page feel unhurried.
